ModMetaData.name: Fcitx CJK Input
ModMetaData.author: scarf
ModMetaData.description:
Fcitx5 CJK input support for RimWorld on Linux.
Connects Unity's native SDL2/fcitx5 input context to RimWorld IMGUI text fields. Supports physical IME toggle keys, preedit text, commits, and cursor placement.
Steam launch options: XMODIFIERS=@im=fcitx SDL_IM_MODULE=fcitx %command%
Requirements: - Native Linux RimWorld 1.6 - Harmony - fcitx5 - libdbus-1.so.3
